items.name: Primary
items.role: The single brand color. White type and white CTA outlines on the black canvas.

items.name: Link
items.role: The only non-monochrome color in the system — a desaturated ice-blue used on inline anchor links and rarely on focus states. Bugatti's brand discipline is so t…

items.name: Canvas
items.role: The default page floor across every surface. Pure black.

items.name: Surface Soft
items.role: A barely-different-from-black tone used for spec table rows and dense data sections.

items.name: Surface Card
items.role: Cards (career callout, newsroom article container, occasional content cards). Even card surfaces stay nearly-black — no contrast jump.

items.name: Surface Elevated
items.role: One step further from black, used for nested cards on rare dense pages.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: The 1px divider tone. Visible but quiet. Used on table rows, between body sections, around card outlines.

items.name: Hairline Strong
items.role: A heavier divider used on the underside of input fields (input fields have no border — only an underline hairline).

items.name: Ink / On Dark
items.role: All headline and primary text on dark canvas.

items.name: Body
items.role: Default running-text color (slightly cooler than pure white). Used in body paragraphs.

items.name: Muted
items.role: Footer links, dates, captions, secondary metadata. Dembrandt's frequency analysis confirms this as palette-2 (count 6, medium confidence).

items.name: Muted Soft
items.role: A second-tier muted for very-secondary text (legal disclaimer, copyright line).

items.name: Warning
items.role: Reserved for technical-warning callouts (specifications, recall notices). Almost never appears on marketing surfaces.

items.name: Success
items.role: Order confirmation states (rare on marketing pages).
